_README: Suburbs a stock document cannot state for itself, checked by hand against the developer's own published address. Each rule may match three ways, most precise first: `url` is the exact source_url; `project` is a lowercase substring tested against the row's builder_name and estate_name; `title` is a lowercase substring tested against the document's own front page. url alone is NOT enough -- builders re-upload price lists to fresh links and the rows follow the new URL, so a url-only rule silently stops applying and those listings go back to having no suburb. Keep `evidence` filled in: it is what lets the next person re-check the claim instead of trusting it.

rules.evidence: Victoria & Albert, 20 Albert Ave Broadbeach QLD 4218
Ancora at Collins Wharf, 971 Collins St Docklands VIC 3008
rules.title: collins wharf

rules.evidence: Senso by DASCO, 242-244 Beecroft Rd Epping NSW 2121

rules.title: dairy farmers

The Fawkner, Fawkner Park / St Kilda Road, Melbourne VIC 3004 - the tower fronts St Kilda Road; 'Fawkner Park West' is the release name, and Fawkner itself is a suburb 15 km north that this project has nothing to do with
The Millwell, 2 Millwell Road East, Maroochydore QLD 4558 (Habitat Development Group). Millwell Road is in Maroochydore, not Morayfield
Aston Junction, 493 Mountain Highway, Bayswater VIC 3153 - industrial unit development. Bayswater also exists in WA, so the state is pinned here

Danks St District, 903-921 Bourke Street, Waterloo NSW 2017 (DASCO). The price list's own header reads 'Danks St. District - [Bourke St Residences]', which is why an earlier filename rule tried to call it Bourke -- a NSW town 760 km west

St Clair, 11 Waterside Retreat, Birtinya QLD 4575 (Habitat Development Group) - two towers on Lake Kawana, which is why the rows read 'Lake View'. Not St Clair NSW or St Clair SA, both of which are localities

Stockland's Kings Forest, an 869-hectare masterplanned community on the Tweed Coast in the Tweed Shire, NSW, adjacent to Casuarina and near Kingscliff. Kings Forest is a locality in NSW and nowhere else. The ten rows record QLD and their state_source reads 'e-agent page' - the state was taken from the page the flyer was listed on, not the property, and four are already flagged 'conflicting signals'

Solara Kings Beach, 19-21 Verney Street, Kings Beach QLD 4551 (Citimax). apartments.com.au lists 7 floors, 23 residences, apartments AND skyhomes, three and four bedroom - the price list has exactly that shape: lots 01-22, Skyhome from level 6, 3-4 bed. The document itself names no locality anywhere in its full text.

The Highgate, Dornoch Terrace, Highgate Hill QLD 4101 (Pointcorp) - a 10-storey apartment building, matching the price list's Level / Apt # / Aspect / Body Corp columns. Every QLD development named Highgate is in Highgate Hill; there is no other QLD locality called Highgate.

Yarra Park Townhomes Stage 1, 65 Parkview Road, Alphington VIC 3078 (U-Home Oceania, Rothelowman). Corroborated inside this catalogue: the separate Parkview Properties price list already resolves to Alphington off its own address.
KNEW, 82 New Street, South Kingsville VIC 3015 (Frater Group, IN8 Architects) - 32 townhouses in two, three and four bedroom configurations; the price list carries 4/3.5/2 types.

Port Lane, 201 Williamstown Road, Port Melbourne VIC 3207 (ID_Land, Rothelowman). Decisive: 'Sea Breeze' is one of Port Lane's six named floorplans - 3 bed, 2 bath, 2 car - and appears verbatim in this stock list's rows.

The document says so itself, in a Comments column the extractor does not read: 'Large Terrace design with own street access. Fronting Greensill Rd' and 'looking over parkland area towards Creek'. Greensill Road is in Albany Creek QLD 4035, which also carries townhouse developments of this type.
The project names its own town: 'Canvas Cooroy'. Cooroy is a QLD locality (Noosa hinterland, 4563) and the rows record QLD. The price list itself names no locality anywhere in its text.
